_about: DRAFT region proposal for Dev A to approve before final processing. Not scene.json. Owner: Student A. Source: SVS 3912 'orig' 2048x1024 frames.
shape: All regions are circles (Dev A decision). Radius 61 px (about 10.7 degrees) was chosen to cover the same area as the earlier 171x68 boxes; confirm the radius with Dev A.
map: Equirectangular 2048x1024. x = (lon + 180) * 2048 / 360, y = (90 - lat) * 1024 / 180. See map_geometry in source_manifest.json.
how_scored: Rough estimate by Student A's planning script using the alignment formula in docs/mapping_spec.md (gradient threshold 8, land plus a 3 px coast margin excluded). Frames 23000, 23040, 23080, 23116, 25000. Dev A's features.py gives the real numbers.
for_dev_b: scene.schema.json only has box_px. Each circle also lists box_px = its bounding square [cx-r, cy-r, 2r, 2r], so the current app can draw it today. Drawing real circles needs center_px and radius_px added to the schema, types.ts and SceneView.tsx. The mask (white = included) will be the circle minus land.
